# partna-bridge

> Self-hosted bridge between a client site and a partner-program engine. Holds the tenant key on the
> server, keeps the partner binding in an HttpOnly cookie, queues orders and refunds, receives signed
> webhooks.

## What this service does and does not do

- Does: attribution of visitors to partners, reporting facts (`order`, `refund`, `member`), issuing
  partner links, signature-checked webhooks, a local delivery queue.
- Does not: hold money, make payouts, calculate commissions, know payment providers, store personal
  data. The engine calculates; the host owns contracts, KYC, taxes and transfers.

## Integration levels

Read one file, in this order of growth. Each level is independent; higher levels do not replace the
lower ones.

- [Level 1 — ready link](docs/integrations/level-1-link.md): the owner creates a partner in the
  cabinet and sends a link. No code on the owner side.
- [Level 2 — own signup](docs/integrations/level-2-signup.md): the owner's backend claims the member
  after its own registration and issues the partner link from its own UI.
- [Level 3 — own graph](docs/integrations/level-3-own-graph.md): the owner's CRM is the source of
  truth and sends `member` facts with a sponsor.
- [Level 4 — own screens](docs/integrations/level-4-own-screens.md): the owner shows balances and
  payouts inside its own cabinet.

Map of all levels and the "what to choose" table: [docs/integrations/README.md](docs/integrations/README.md).

## Contracts

- OpenAPI: `/openapi.json` of a running bridge (typed bodies for `order`, `refund`, `member`).
- Field reference and mistakes that cost money: [docs/integrations/fields.md](docs/integrations/fields.md).
- Installation: [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md).
- Agent instructions for installation: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- Checks against a live bridge: `./scripts/smoke.sh --level 1 --url https://bridge.example`.

## Partner access

Partners do not sign up. The platform gives them a link `/p/<token>`: thirty days, reusable,
and it slides — every visit issues a fresh token, so an active partner never hits the term.
A one-time fifteen-minute entry exists for opening the cabinet on the owner's device.

If an owner wants no links at all, the partner uses the owner's own account and the owner's
backend reads the dashboard from the engine (level 4). The bridge does not proxy reads.

## Facts the engine expects

`amount` is always in minor units (350000 with `RUB` is 3 500 ₽). `eventId` must be stable across
retries: the queue drops duplicates by it and the engine deduplicates by it too.
